Chapter 6785: Only The Self

Chapter 6785: Only The Self

“What else, just trying to befriend the villainous heaven.” The baldy barked back.

“You can do as you please.” Li Qiye said disinterestedly.

“Bah, if you end up killing the villainous heaven, how can I befriend him?” The baldy complained.

“Don’t you have enough friends and brothers already? Those dark geezers, how long do you think they can survive?” Li Qiye said.

“Sigh, that’s out of my hands, everyone has their own fate, I am not a savior. If someone wants to die, I’m not going to save them.” The baldy rubbed his smooth head.

“Then what are you up to?” Li Qiye said: “And these games.”

“Games?” The baldy became irritated after hearing the disdainful words and glared at Li Qiye: “This is called a career, do you know what that is? Of course not, you only know how to run around scheming.”

“A career right? Not just following your continuously changing whims?” Li Qiye retorted.

“Don’t you see that this enterprise is the greatest...” He arched his chest proudly.

“Doesn’t look like you care much about it.” Li Qiye said.

“Can’t you be nice for once? Always cawing about negative stuff.” He said.

“If you actually care, you wouldn’t be playing around.” Li Qiye said.

As for the ordinary youth, he stood with his hands crossed in front of his chest, just enjoying the dysfunctional family.

“I toiled for all these resources.” He mumbled.

“What is your goal?” Li Qiye asked.

“Are you going to invest in me, old man?” He asked.

“No.” Li Qiye refused.

“I don’t know why I bothered asking, already knew you were a heartless bastard who doesn’t recognize your own kin.” He glared at Li Qiye.

“Not the first time I’ve been a heartless bastard.” Li Qiye calmly admitted.

“I agree.” The youth chimed in.

“Agree with what? I was merciful just throwing you into the eye of the sea.” Li Qiye said.

“And? Just throw me in again.” The youth grumbled.

“It won’t be just the eye of the sea next time.” Li Qiye said.

“What would you do instead?” The baldy became curious.

“What else but to throw him into the bottom of the nine worlds. Perhaps he’ll survive long enough to see the sun after a shift in landscape.” Li Qiye said.

“That’s a bit ruthless.” The baldy patted the youth and said: “Best not to argue with him or you will find yourself in a world of trouble.”

The youth swallowed his frustration and stopped speaking.

“Okay, old man, you’ve never given me money before. That’s why, how about a little bit of your attention?” The baldy said.

“Are you begging me?” Li Qiye asked.

“If that’s how you want to phrase it, sure.” The baldy knew it was time to comply. He pulled out a lightning bolt and asked with a smile: “Take a look, is this salvageable?”

The bolt was damaged, flickering faintly. Nevertheless, it still contained the power of the high heaven.

“This is not under my jurisdiction. The villainous heaven has to do it.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“This wouldn’t have happened if you hadn’t thrown the source bolt next to him.” The baldy angrily said.

“He did what he should have, and now he’s returning to where he came from.” Li Qiye said.

“Bah, your comment reeks of unrighteousness. He had a perfect life, why was he forced to go die?” The baldy said.

“Because this is what he is.” Li Qiye said indifferently: “If he couldn’t sever the karma, it must be repaid in the end. Otherwise, what use is karma if everyone can escape?”

“...” The baldy froze for a moment before lowering his head: “Damn it, I knew I couldn’t argue against you, old man.”

“Because I speak the truth.” Li Qiye said.

“Old man, you stand so high now, you can still save him, right?” The baldy didn’t give up.

“Of course, but it’s not what I should do. He must return from whence he came.” Li Qiye said.

“That’s the same as pushing him off the cliff.” The baldy said.

“The solution is to kill the high heaven, then it won’t have anything to do with him anymore.” Li Qiye said.

“...” The baldy glanced at the bolt.

“You want to save him?” Li Qiye asked.

“Obviously.” The baldy said: “That’s why I opened this enterprise, to get some money and buy some things that might be useful.”

“It’s useless.” Li Qiye said: “Outside of me and the high heaven, there is one more path.”

“Which is?” The baldy became excited again.

“Himself.” Li Qiye said: “His own enlightenment. He will be able to live again without a problem.”

“And if he can’t?” The baldy asked.

“Then karma comes into play.” Li Qiye said.

“Choosing not to save when you can. No wonder everyone hates you, heh, not a good person at all.” The baldy said.

“Perhaps I’m not a person.” Li Qiye said slowly.

“What?” The baldy became startled and took a step back: “Old man, don’t scare me like that, I have a small heart.”

“Have you seen anyone like me?” Li Qiye asked.

“No.” The baldy said: “Maybe you have a point. If this continues, you won’t be one anymore.”

“As for you?” Li Qiye asked.

“Of course I’m a person, and a kind one at that, friends with all.” The baldy declared.

“This is your chosen path?” Li Qiye asked again.

“None of your business, you can walk your path and I walk mine, I don’t want to follow you.” The baldy said.

“Not a problem.” Li Qiye responded: “If it is chosen, then continue onward, don’t be so whimsical.”

“Please, my dao heart is as solid as steel, there’s no problem comparing mine to any in all worlds...” The baldy said.

Li Qiye’s smirk made him stop.

“What’s with the smile?” The baldy said.

“You make it sound as if you have the greatest dao heart in history, I almost believed it for a second.” Li Qiye said.

“Okay fine, you have the number one, I’m number two, my statement still stands.” The baldy said.

“There is no number one or number two, only the self.” Li Qiye patted his shoulder.

“Bah, I’m not like you.” The baldy said dismissively: “The path you walk is lonely until death. I’m the type who has friends everywhere.”

“Since you have so many friends, I’m sure you know what’s going on in Heavenrealm, right?” Li Qiye chuckled.

“Like what?” He became alarmed.

“Just have a few questions, that’s all.” Li Qiye said.
